findings.text: When _actionHandler exists but this.parent is null (e.g., root command), the 'command:<name>' event is never emitted; original code emitted on this. Failing input: root command with _actionHandler and listeners on 'command:<rootname>' - listeners never fire.

When no _actionHandler exists and no parent exists, the 'command:<name>' event is skipped entirely; original code emitted on this. Failing input: standalone subcommand without _actionHandler expecting command event - event silently dropped.

0.reason: This is the same root cause as the reference bug: the command event is emitted on this.parent instead of this, so when this.parent is null the event is never emitted, masking the command event with the earlier unknown-option error.

1.reason: This is the same root cause as the reference bug: the command event is skipped when this.parent is null, so the command event is masked by the unknown-option error.
